validity.recommendation: Rule whether P5989 should be narrowed to the new Berdyansk to Melitopol part or merged with P7817, P7818 and P1457.
validity.researcher_notes: Kommersant in July 2022 describes one project made of two parts: restore the old Taganrog-Mariupol-Berdyansk trunk, then build new pipe from Berdyansk to Melitopol. DAN in July 2023 calls the same work Taganrog-Melitopol. Row P1457 holds the old trunk, rows P7817 and P7818 hold its rebuilt stretches, and P5989 spans Taganrog to Melitopol, so Taganrog to Berdyansk is likely counted twice. The sources do not give lengths that settle the split. The pipe exists, so this is overlap and not a missing line.

validity.recommendation: Check the StartYear1 of 2024. The only found evidence is that work began in 2023.
validity.researcher_notes: The 2024 start year came from a TASS item that I could not load today. A 2022 report says gas reached Berdyansk and Melitopol in October 2022. The 2023 work is re-laying of an existing corridor. The recorded start of 2024 is unproven.

fills.researcher_notes: Searched DAN, Kommersant and United24. None gives a capacity. A 2024 TASS item says pressure doubled and volume rose half again, but gives no figure and I could not load it today.

Searched DAN 2023, Kommersant 2022 and United24 2025. None states a diameter for the Taganrog-Melitopol line. The Mariupol-Berdyansk stretches are Ду700 and Ду500 on rows P7817 and P7818, but those are not this row's figure.
Searched DAN 2023, Kommersant 2022 and United24 2025. Kommersant says the new Berdyansk to Melitopol part is over 100 km, but that is one part, not the whole row.

Kommersant Jul 2022: from Berdyansk a new pipeline must be built to Melitopol.

fills.researcher_notes: DAN names Taganrog-Melitopol. Kommersant, a separate publisher, describes the plan of using the old Taganrog-Mariupol-Berdyansk trunk and building new pipe from Berdyansk to Melitopol.
No source names who runs the line. It sits in occupied territory, so the Ukrainian gas transmission operator would be wrong to name and an occupation body cannot be named without qualification.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The sheet's operating ref is a 2024 TASS item that I could not load today. DAN in July 2023 says re-laying began. United24 in July 2025 says pipelines were still being built from Taganrog through Mariupol and Berdyansk toward Melitopol. I found no loaded source dated 2024 or later that says gas is flowing on this row. The 2022 Kommersant report says gas already reached Berdyansk. No change staged.

summary: "Real corridor but overlaps P1457/P7817/P7818, duplicate concern; operating unclear; diameter, length, capacity, operator unresolved"
